'''Kani Asari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. Stationed at the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as of [[43 ABY]], she was assigned as Interim [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]]'s personal assistant as he was dealing with the crisis between the Order and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

When Alliance fugitives-turned-liaison officers [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] arrived at the Temple to negotiate a working treaty of sorts between [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Apprentice Asari received the pair in the main entrance hall and escorted them to a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] in the [[Great Hall (Jedi Temple)/Legends|Great Hall]] that took them to a conference chamber deep in the Temple. Later, when Daala ordered [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|besiege]] the Temple, Asari tried to negotiate with the Mandalorian commander, [[Belok Rhal]]. However, he simply noted that she was neither Saar nor Altamik, and shot her at point-blank range, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her, much to the shock of the Jedi. After Asari's death, Galactic Alliance Chief of Staff [[Wynn Dorvan]] carried her body from the Temple steps after his routine lunch with Jedi [[Raynar Thul]].
